items.name: Universal Bulk Bags
items.short: The base series for most bulk cargo. Our most popular model, always available in stock.
items.description: The universal bulk bag is our base and most popular series. It suits the majority of free-flowing materials: chemical raw materials, mineral powders, grain and feed. Standard sizes are always kept in stock, so lead time is short. Various top options (open, duffle, filling spout) and bottom options (flat, discharge spout) are available.
features: Popular sizes always available in stock
Top options: open / duffle / filling spout
items.applications: Chemical raw materials, mineral powders, cement, grain, feed
items.imageAlt: Universal FIBC bulk bag for free-flowing materials

items.name: Food Grade Bulk Bags
items.short: Virgin material approved for food contact. For flour, sugar, salt and starch.
items.description: Food grade bulk bags are made from virgin material approved for direct food contact. The construction meets food safety requirements, supported by ISO 22000 food safety management certification. They are used for packing flour, sugar, salt, starch, food additives, grain, pulses, dates and animal feed.
features: Virgin material approved for food contact
White finish, specially for food products
items.applications: Flour, sugar, salt, starch, spices, dates, food additives, grain, pulses, nuts, feed
items.imageAlt: Food grade bulk bag for flour and sugar

items.name: Heavy Duty Bulk Bags
items.short: Reinforced fabric and loops for heavy, dense cargo. 2, 4 or 6 loops with reinforced base.
items.description: The heavy duty series is designed for heavy and dense materials where ordinary fabric works at its limit. We increase the fabric density, use reinforced seams and 2, 4 or 6 lifting loops, plus a reinforced base to spread the load evenly. This allows safe transport of loads up to 2.5 tonnes.
features: Reinforced base for even load distribution
items.applications: Ore, crushed stone, silica sand, metal powder, dense minerals, refractories
items.imageAlt: Heavy duty bulk bag for dense cargo

items.name: Bulk Bags with Inner Baffles
items.short: Inner baffles keep a cube shape when partly filled — up to 30% more bags per container.
items.description: Bulk bags with inner baffles (internal partitions) keep a cube shape even when only partly filled. This is a key advantage for container shipping: bags do not bulge or collapse, they stack stably on pallets and in the warehouse, allowing up to 30% more units per container and reducing transport cost per tonne.
features: Up to 30% more bags per container
items.applications: Resins, chemical powders, food ingredients, additives

items.name: Acid & Alkali Resistant Bulk Bags
items.short: Special fabric and coating for aggressive chemical environments.
items.description: For packing aggressive chemical products we produce acid and alkali resistant bulk bags. A special fabric and protective coating resistant to acids and alkalis is used, preventing bag degradation and product contamination during long-term storage and transport.
features: Fabric and coating resistant to acids and alkalis
Prevents bag degradation in aggressive environments
Optional inner liner for extra protection
items.applications: Chemical reagents, acids, alkalis, aggressive powders, fertilizers
items.imageAlt: Acid and alkali resistant bulk bag for chemicals

items.name: Heat Resistant Container Bags
items.short: Withstand loading of material at elevated temperature.
items.description: Heat resistant container bags are designed for packing products at elevated temperature — for example after drying, calcination or hot grinding. A fabric resistant to thermal impact is used, preventing deformation and failure of the bag when hot material is loaded.
items.applications: Calcined materials, cement, lime, hot grinding, refractory powders
items.imageAlt: Heat resistant container bag for hot materials

items.name: Conductive Container Bags TYPE-D
items.short: Dissipative fabric, no grounding required. For combustible dust in high-risk areas.
items.description: The TYPE-D container bag is made from dissipative fabric that disperses static charge without the need for grounding. This is a convenient and reliable solution for packing products that generate combustible dust, where a grounding circuit cannot be provided. It reduces the risk of ignition from static discharge.
features: Reduced ignition risk from static discharge
items.applications: Chemical powders, combustible dust, polymer granules, solvents

items.name: Antistatic Container Bags TYPE-C
items.short: Conductive threads with grounding point. Maximum static protection level.
items.description: The TYPE-C container bag is made from fabric with interwoven conductive threads connected to a grounding point. When correctly connected to a grounding circuit, it provides continuous static discharge and the highest level of protection when handling combustible powders and in environments with a high ignition risk.
features: Complies with international FIBC safety practice
items.applications: Chemical powders, solvents, flammable substances, paints and coatings
